messages:
Maria: Heads up — marketplace launch is ~72h out. Quick sync: who's owning localized landing pages, press embargo, SI playbook, and oncall roster?
Ben: I can take the press assets. Draft blog goes live Thu EOD unless embargo changes. Need final partner quotes and logo approvals by Wed 18:00 PT.
Liam: Product side: pricing tiles + model spec copy are ready. We still need hardware partner logo variants (svg/png) and the compliance blurb from Legal.
Sophia: Engineering: scheduled a canary deploy Wed 02:00 UTC. Will spin up dedicated namespace for partner traffic. Need a rollback play and a short runbook for SI teams.
Chandra: SI partners confirmed coverage for NA/EU/APAC. I'll hand over a troubleshooting doc and run a 30-min playthrough with each SI on Wed. Need access to the canary namespace creds (read-only).
Ola: Legal: approved partner co-sell language. One ask — final asset bundle (logos + quotes) must be sent no later than Wed 18:00 PT for trademark checks. Also confirm embargo window.
Maria: Cool. Embargo window requested by marketing is Thu 15:00 UTC (public) with a partner preview at Thu 12:00 UTC. Can everyone confirm they can meet Wed 18:00 PT deadline?
Ben: Confirmed from Marketing. I'll also include an embargoed link to the draft blog and press kit in Drive: https://drive.redwood.example/marketplace/embargoed
Liam: Confirmed for Product. We'll add the hardware badge and short compatibility matrix.
Sophia: Confirmed for Eng, but need one short item: a single Slack channel for rollback communication (prefer #marketplace-rollback). Can Ops create it?
Maria: @Ops — can you please create #marketplace-rollback and add Maria, Sophia, Chandra, Ben, Liam, Ola?
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: service/marketplace-canary -> Wed 02:00 UTC. Logs will stream to https://kibana.redwood.example/marketplace-canary
Chandra: I'll book 3x 15-min runthroughs with SI leads Wed 09:00/13:00/20:00 PT to cover regions. Will post invites.
Ola: Also flagged an embargo fallback clause: if any partner asks to delay, we need written sign-off 2 hours before public time.
Ben: Noted. I'll circulate a short partner checklist with times + contact points.
Maria: Quick checklist (pinning here):
```
- Press kit final -> Wed 18:00 PT (Ben)
- Partner logos + trademarks -> Wed 18:00 PT (Chandra + partners)
- Legal compliance blurb -> Wed 18:00 PT (Ola)
- Localized landing pages (en, fr, de, ja) -> Wed 23:00 PT (Product + Localization)
- Canary deploy -> Wed 02:00 UTC (Sophia)
- SI runthroughs scheduled -> Wed (Chandra)
- Rollback channel #marketplace-rollback -> Ops
- Final partner sign-off for embargo -> 2h before public (Partners)
```
Maria: Please react with :thumbsup: once your line is green or reply with blockers. Trying to keep the thread concise so Ops/Oncall can triage quickly.
Ben: :thumbsup: will send final email to partners once all assets in Drive.
Sophia: One blocker: we need a short healthcheck script SI can run that hits /healthz and returns JSON with tokens. I'll drop it in the Drive repo in 30m.
Chandra: Acknowledged — will prod SI teams to test the healthcheck in the Wed runthroughs.
Ola: :thumbsup: No legal blockers beyond the trademark timing.
Maria: Thanks team — I'll follow up with a slim status update tomorrow morning. If anything urgent, ping me directly.
